description: Receipt in late Hebrew script. Mentions Miṣrayim (Cairo). The first line is a name: Moshe(?) Mizrāḥī, with the latter word more clearly rendered. The middle section is a weight designation of ١ and the Judaeo-Arabic text just below that reads: "only one" (faqaṭ wāḥid). For a similar receipt in a distinct scribal hand, see: T-S AS 215.312 (PGPID 22884). MCD.
description_he: מסמך לא מזוהה בכתב עברי מאוחר. מזכיר מצריים (פוסטאט/קהיר).
